name: Cookie puncher
summary:
Welcome to Cookie Puncher VR — the only place where smashing cookies is not just allowed… it’s encouraged.

Step into a  world where your fists are the ultimate baking tool. Punch, crush, fling, and obliterate cookies in wildly satisfying ways. Whether you're going for precision hits or full-on cookie carnage, every swing counts.

🥊 Features:

cookie smashing
crunchy feedback
Built exclusively for VR interaction

This is stress relief… but tastier.
